correctness.rationale: The local inequalities are precisely the synchronous open-neighbor fixed-point rule with ties retained; at n=3 the horizontal neighbors are distinct. The pair-state overlap recovers the full cyclic column string with its specified starting index, so closed walks count labelled configurations via tr(T^n), without a rotation quotient. A fresh exact reproduction gives 110 transitions, SCC sizes 20 and 44 singletons, and characteristic polynomial X^46(X−1)^5(X+1)^2pqr as claimed. This finite certificate works for the trace at every n, independently of diagonalizability. A separate vertex-neighbor enumeration agrees at n=3–6 (8, 36, 78, 146). Exact strict Schur reductions for q and r at radius 2 and the derivative and product for p give a simple leading rho, bracketed by 2.2055 and 2.2056, with all other eigenvalues below 2 in modulus. An independently constructed comparison matrix for the triangular cross-section confirms a simple eigenvalue 3 and all other moduli below 2, establishing the ratio with leading constant 1.
